lines.t: Rachum v’chanun Atah. (You are merciful and gracious.)
Hu nasa et avoneinu, (He bore our sins,)
U’vachavurato nirpa lanu. (And by His wounds we are healed.)
Hashalom shelo alaynu, (His peace upon us,)
Hu shalom lanu. (Is peace for us.)
U’kayam brit chadashah. (And established a new covenant.)
Baruch haba (Blessed is He who comes)
B’shem Adonai. (In the name of the Lord.)
